# signoz_ingestion_key_limit (Resource)

Manages a single rate limit attached to an ingestion key. Keys and limits are separate server objects: deleting the key removes its limits, but limits are created, updated and deleted through their own endpoints.

-> A limit sets a ceiling for one telemetry signal (`logs`, `traces` or `metrics`) on one ingestion key, with independent `day` and/or `second` arms; each arm can bound `size` (bytes), `count` (requests), or both. At least one arm must be set.

`key_id` and `signal` are immutable: changing either replaces the limit (the server has no move/re-signal operation). `config` and `tags` update in place. Deleting the parent key removes its limits via the server's cascade, but limits are created, updated and deleted through their own endpoints — the replacement for the removed `rate_limits { day_limit, second_limit }` block on `signoz_ingestion_key`.

The `signoz_ingestion_key` data source exposes the key's limits read-only, including the server-computed `metric` enforcement snapshot; that list is informational — manage limits with this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    signoz = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/signoz/signoz"
    }
  }
}

provider "signoz" {
  endpoint     = "http://localhost:3301"
  access_token = "<SIGNOZ-API-KEY>"
}

resource "signoz_ingestion_key" "production" {
  name = "Production Ingest Key"
  tags = ["production", "team-a"]
}

# Bound production logs to 1M requests / 1 GB per day and 1k requests per second.
resource "signoz_ingestion_key_limit" "logs_daily" {
  key_id = signoz_ingestion_key.production.id
  signal = "logs"

  config = {
    day = {
      count = 1000000
      size  = 1073741824
    }
    second = {
      count = 1000
    }
  }

  tags = ["tier:gold"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Attributes) Limit configuration. At least one of `day` or `second` must be set; within an arm any of `size` (bytes) or `count` (requests) may be left out to leave that dimension unbounded. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `key_id` (String) ID of the ingestion key the limit applies to. Changing it replaces the limit (the server has no move operation).
- `signal` (String) Telemetry signal the limit applies to. One of `logs`, `traces`, `metrics`. Immutable once set; changing it replaces the limit.

### Optional

- `tags` (List of String) Tags associated with the limit.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time of the limit (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Autogenerated unique ID for the limit.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time of the limit (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `day` (Attributes) Per-day ceiling. Omit for no daily limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--day))
- `second` (Attributes) Per-second ceiling. Omit for no rate limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config--second))

<a id="nestedatt--config--day"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.day`

Optional:

- `count` (Number) Maximum requests per day. Omit for unbounded.
- `size` (Number) Maximum bytes per day. Omit for unbounded.


<a id="nestedatt--config--second"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config.second`

Optional:

- `count` (Number) Maximum requests per second. Omit for unbounded.
- `size` (Number) Maximum bytes per second. Omit for unbounded.

## Import

Import by limit ID (`key_id` is recovered from the server on the follow-up read):

```shell
terraform import signoz_ingestion_key_limit.<limit-alias> <limit-id>
```
